svg.text: Gcd(a, b) pulls a singleton set fiber over each input pair
A dependent type is an indexed family of sets (a, b) ↦ Gcd(a, b) ⊂ ℕ; for (12, 8), the fiber is {4}
1. Base Space of Input Values: (a, b) ∈ ℕ × ℕ
Each cell (a, b) is shaded by the inhabitant of its fiber Gcd(a, b)
Faint cells have coprime inputs: fiber is {1}; cell (0,0) has fiber {0}
Refinement selects the unique g with Div(g) = Div(12) ∩ Div(8)
Gcd(12, 8) = { g ∈ ℕ | Div(g) = Div(12) ∩ Div(8) }
Subtyping is Set Containment: Gcd(12, 8) = {4} ⊂ ℕ
Only g = 4 satisfies Div(g) = Div(12) ∩ Div(8); every other natural is excluded.
